blurb: Guests can join scheduled adventure cruises or book private charters for customized sailing experiences around Catalina Island. Options include afternoon sails, sunset cruises, half-day and full-day trips, with opportunities for swimming, snorkeling, and paddle boarding. Overnight stays are available on the mooringside B&B sailboat.

quotes.author: Adventure Cruises
quotes.text: When you cruise with us you get to experience the tranquility of having the engine off and the sails up. We’ve found that the peacefulness of sailing attracts more wildlife. We’ve had pods of dolphins swim with us for miles, it’s a thrilling sight to see.
